info.title: Clowder
info.description: The API of Clowder for desktop clients. Log in with POST /auth/login, then send the token of the answer as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Bodies are JSON (at most 64 KiB), names are in snake_case, times are RFC 3339 in UTC and IDs are numbers. Every error is {"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}. A path the API does not have is 404 not_found and a known path in a wrong method is 405 method_not_allowed with the Allow header; neither is an operation of this document.

tags.name: me
tags.description: The logged-in user and their sessions.

tags.name: uploads
tags.description: Files for posts, and their download.

tags.name: board
tags.description: The Kanban board of a room: columns and cards.

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Mentions, replies, assignments and additions to rooms.

post.description: Checks the username and the password and starts a session of the kind api. After 5 failed attempts for the username or the address within 15 minutes, further attempts get 429 until the window has passed. A wrong username and a wrong password are answered alike.

requestBody.description: The credentials and the name of the client.

post.description: Does what the sign-up page does: makes the user from an invitation, uses the invitation up and logs the new user in with a session of the kind api.

requestBody.description: The invitation, the new account and the name of the client.

get.description: Says whether an invitation can still be used and which role it gives. A used, expired or unknown invitation is 404, and the answer does not say which.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token of the invitation link.

post.description: Deletes the session of the token. The token stops working at once.

get.description: Returns the user of the token and the unread counts of the sidebar.
Lists the live sessions of the user, browsers and apps, with the one of this request marked as current.

delete.description: Ends a session of the user, which logs that browser or app out. A session of someone else is 404.

get.description: Lists the enabled users whose username or display name starts with q, in any case, ordered by username, 20 at most. Without q it lists the first 20.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a username or of a display name.

get.description: Lists the rooms the user sees, by name without regard to case: every visible room and the private rooms the user is a member of. is_member says which the user has joined. A private room the user is not in is not listed, an admin included.

post.description: Makes a room with the user as its first member and the columns To do, In progress and Done. Visible rooms are made by admins only (403 forbidden for anyone else); private rooms by anyone. A name is 1 to 64 characters and unique without regard to case, a description at most 500; mistakes are 422 invalid_input with fields name, description and visibility.

Location.description: The path of the new resource.

get.description: Returns a visible room, which every user reads before joining, or a private room the user is a member of. Any other room is 404, an admin's too.

patch.description: Changes the name and the description that the body has and returns the room; a field that is left out, or null, stays. The visibility of a room does not change. Admins may in any room, the creator in a room they can still read (D29); another member gets 403 forbidden and a user who may not know a private room 404. Nothing changes, and no audit event is written, when the values are the room's own.

200.description: The room as it is now.

delete.description: Deletes the room with its posts, comments, tasks, attachments and members. Admins may in any room (D29), the creator in a room they can still read; a member who is neither gets 403 forbidden.

post.description: Makes the user a member of a visible room. Joining a room the user is in is not an error. A private room the user is not in is 404.
Removes the user from the room. Leaving a room the user is not in is not an error. A private room the user is not in is 404; one that ends with no members is kept for admins to delete.

204.description: The user is not a member.

get.summary: List the members of a room
get.description: Lists the members of a room the user can read, by display name.

post.summary: Add a member to a room
post.description: Adds a user to the room, who is notified. Any member of the room may. Adding a user who is a member is not an error. A user who does not exist or is disabled is 422 with the field user_id. A visible room the caller has not joined is 403 forbidden.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a room
delete.description: Removes a user from the room. Only admins may, in any room (D29); everyone else gets 403 forbidden, or 404 for a private room they are not in. Removing a user who is not a member is not an error.

204.description: The user is not a member.

get.summary: Find users to add to a room
get.description: Lists the enabled users who are not members of the room and whose username or display name starts with q, in any case, ordered by username, 20 at most. Without q it lists the first 20. Only members of the room may ask (403 forbidden for a visible room the user has not joined).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a username or of a display name.

get.summary: Read the feed of a room
get.description: Returns a page of the top-level posts of a room the user can read, newest first. Without before it starts at the newest post; with before it returns the posts older than that ID. limit is 30 by default and at most 100 (422 above, and for anything that is not a positive number). next_before is the before of the next page and null on the last. A deleted post that has replies is in the feed as deleted.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The ID of the last post of the previous page (its next_before).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The size of the page, 1 to 100; 30 when left out.

post.description: Writes a post in a room. Only members post (403 forbidden for a visible room the user has not joined). The body is at most 20,000 characters; a post needs a body, an attachment or a task. Fields that are left out are empty and the format is text. attachment_ids must be empty here: a new post has nothing to keep. Mistakes are 422 invalid_input with fields named as in the request (tasks has one message that names the row: Task 2: ...).

Location.description: The path of the new resource.

get.summary: Get a post or a comment
get.description: Returns a post or a comment of a room the user can read. One that was deleted but stays for its replies comes back with deleted true and no author, body or html; one that was deleted without replies is 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

patch.summary: Edit a post or a comment
patch.description: Changes a post or comment and returns it. Only the author may (403 forbidden for another reader). What the body leaves out, or sets to null, stays as it is: format, body, tags, tasks and attachment_ids. A list that is there replaces the list: tags is exactly those tags, tasks exactly those tasks (an entry with an id is that task edited, one without is new, a task that is not listed is deleted), attachment_ids exactly those attachments of the post (the others are removed). upload_ids add new files. The post then shows edited_at.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

200.description: The post as it is now.

delete.summary: Delete a post or a comment
delete.description: Deletes a post or comment. The author or an admin may (403 forbidden for another reader). One with replies stays as deleted so that its thread keeps its shape; one without replies disappears. Its tasks, attachments, reactions, tags and mentions go with it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

get.description: Returns a top-level post and every comment under it at any depth, as a list in reading order: every comment comes before its replies and siblings are oldest first. A comment's parent_id and depth place it in the tree. The ID may be that of a comment: the thread of its post comes back and focus_id is the comment's ID, otherwise null.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

post.description: Writes a comment under a post or a comment, to any depth, in the thread of the same top-level post. The body of the request and its rules are those of a new post. A deleted post cannot be replied to (404).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

Location.description: The path of the new resource.

put.summary: React to a post or a comment
put.description: Puts the emoji on the post or comment as the user. Only members of the room react (403 forbidden for a visible room the user has not joined). Putting an emoji that is already there is not an error. The answer is the reactions of the post as the user sees them.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

parameters.name: emoji
parameters.description: The emoji, URL-escaped (UTF-8 percent-encoded). Exactly one emoji: a flag, a keycap or a joined sequence such as a family counts as one; several emoji, letters and anything else are 422 with the field emoji.

delete.description: Takes the user's emoji off the post or comment. Taking off one that is not there is not an error. The answer is the reactions of the post as the user sees them.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the post or comment.

parameters.name: emoji
parameters.description: The emoji, URL-escaped (UTF-8 percent-encoded). Exactly one emoji: a flag, a keycap or a joined sequence such as a family counts as one; several emoji, letters and anything else are 422 with the field emoji.

get.description: Lists up to 10 tags that start with prefix, used on posts in rooms the user can read, by name. A leading # and the case of prefix do not matter. Without prefix it lists the first names.

post.description: Stores one file, to be attached to a post or comment that is written or edited next: put the ID of the answer in its upload_ids. The body is multipart/form-data with exactly one file in the field file and nothing else (422 on file otherwise; 415 for another Content-Type). The file is at most the attachment limit of the installation, 25 MB by default (413 too_large), and the request body is cut early when it is much larger. Any logged-in user may upload. The upload is for the user who made it: nobody else can attach it. An upload that no post takes stays on the server until an administrator removes it, so attach what you upload.

get.description: Sends the file of an attachment of a post or comment in a room the user can read, with the checks and the headers of the pages' download. Only an image of the types PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP is served inline with its own Content-Type; every other file is application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition: attachment, whatever its name says. Ranges and If-Modified-Since work. 404 for a room the user cannot read (a private room's non-member, admins included), for a deleted post and for an attachment that does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the attachment (the id of an attachment of a post).

Content-Disposition.description: inline for an image of the types PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP; attachment with the file name for every other file.

Content-Security-Policy.description: A policy that sandboxes the file and lets nothing load or run.

206.description: The part of the file that the Range header asked for.

Content-Disposition.description: inline for an image of the types PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP; attachment with the file name for every other file.

Content-Security-Policy.description: A policy that sandboxes the file and lets nothing load or run.

304.description: The file has not changed since If-Modified-Since.

416.description: The Range header asks for bytes the file does not have.

get.summary: Read the board of a room
get.description: Returns the columns of the board of a room the user can read, left to right, each with its cards from top to bottom. Every card is a task of a post or comment of the room. The last column counts as done. A non-member of a visible room reads the board but cannot change it. A private room the user is not in is 404.

post.description: Adds a column at the right end of the board. Any member of the room may (SPEC D25); a visible room the user has not joined is 403 forbidden. The name is trimmed, 1 to 40 characters, and unique in the room without regard to case (422 on name).

201.description: The new column, with no cards.

Location.description: The path of the board of the room.

patch.description: Renames a column. The rules of the name and of who may are those of adding a column. Renaming it to its own name, or to another case of it, is allowed.

delete.description: Removes a column. A column with cards cannot be removed until its cards are moved, and a room always keeps one column: both are 409 conflict. The rules of who may are those of adding a column.

post.description: Puts the column at a position from the left (from 0). A position below 0 is 0 and one past the end is the end; the positions of the columns stay 0 to n-1. Moving a column to where it is changes nothing. The rules of who may are those of adding a column.

204.description: The column is where it was asked to be.

patch.description: Changes the assignees and the due date of a task and gets the card back. A field that is not in the body stays; due_date null removes the due date; assignee_ids [] unassigns everybody. The title is not here: it is edited with the post (PATCH /posts/{id}), and a title in this body is 422. Any member of the room may; a visible room the user has not joined is 403 forbidden. Newly assigned people are notified.

post.description: Puts the card in a column of its board at a position (from 0, the top, counted in the column without the card). A position below 0 is 0 and one past the end is the end; the positions stay 0 to n-1 in both columns. Moving a card to where it is changes nothing. A column of another room is 404. Any member of the room may; a visible room the user has not joined is 403 forbidden.

204.description: The card is where it was asked to be.

get.description: Searches the posts and comments of the rooms the user can read: visible rooms and the private rooms the user is a member of (admins are no exception). The query q has words (matched as prefixes, in bodies, attachment names and task titles), phrases in double quotes, and the filters #tag (all must match), room:name, from:username, after:YYYY-MM-DD, before:YYYY-MM-DD and is:post or is:comment. A mistake in a date is 422 on q. A query with neither words nor filters finds nothing. A page has 20 results and a page after the 1000th is empty.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The query; the first 500 characters count.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page, from 1; 1 when left out.

get.description: Returns a page of the notifications of the user, newest first. Without before it starts at the newest; with before it returns the ones older than that ID. limit is 30 by default and at most 100 (422 above, and for anything that is not a positive number). next_before is the before of the next page and null on the last. Notifications of a room the user can no longer read are left out.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The size of the page, 1 to 100; 30 when left out.

post.description: Marks the notifications of the user up to an ID as read; newer ones stay unread. Marking ones that are read is not an error.

get.description: Returns this document. It needs no login.

bearer.description: The token of POST /auth/login or POST /auth/signup.

ErrorObject.description: What went wrong. Branch on code, never on message.

code.description: A stable name of the kind of error.

message.description: A short sentence for people; its wording may change.

fields.description: For invalid_input: the problem of each wrong field of the request, by its JSON name (a problem with the body as a whole is under body).

Error.description: The body of every error answer.

username.description: The unique, lower-case name used to log in.

display_name.description: The name shown to other people.

Session.description: A login of the user: a browser or an app. Its token is never shown again.

id.description: The ID of the session, for DELETE /me/sessions/{id}.

kind.description: browser is a login of the web pages, api a login of a client of this API.

client_name.description: The name the client gave when it logged in, or the user agent of the browser; empty for old sessions.

last_seen_at.description: When the session was last used.

expires_at.description: When the session ends if it is not used again.

current.description: True for the session that made this request.

client_name.description: Names this client in the list of the user's sessions, for example the name of the app and of the computer.

invitation_token.description: The token of the invitation link (the last part of <base URL>/invite/<token>).

client_name.description: Names this client in the list of the user's sessions.

TokenResponse.description: A new session: send the token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

token.description: The bearer token. It is shown only now; keep it secret.

expires_at.description: When the session ends if it is not used again; every use moves it 30 days on.

Invitation.description: An invitation link that can be used.

valid.description: Always true: an invitation that cannot be used is a 404.

role.description: The role of the user who signs up with it.

Me.description: Who the token belongs to, and the counts the sidebar of the pages shows.

unread_conversations.description: The number of conversations with unread messages.

sessions.description: The live sessions of the user, the newest first.

users.description: The users, ordered by username, at most 20.

UserRef.description: A person named on a room, a post or a reaction.

display_name.description: The name shown to other people.

Room.description: A room as the user sees it.

name.description: The name, unique without regard to case.

description.description: What the room is for; may be empty.

visibility.description: visible rooms are listed and read by every user; private rooms only by their members.

is_member.description: True when the user is a member; only members post, comment and react.

can_manage.description: True when the user may rename and delete the room: an admin, or its creator.

name.description: The name: 1 to 64 characters, unique without regard to case.

description.description: At most 500 characters; empty when left out.

visibility.description: visible rooms are made by admins only. It cannot be changed later.

name.description: The new name; left out or null keeps it.

description.description: The new description; left out or null keeps it, an empty string clears it.

added_by.description: The member who added the user; null when the user joined by themselves or made the room.

joined_at.description: When the user became a member.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to add.

Task.description: A task written in a post or comment; it is a card on the board of the room.

column_id.description: The ID of the column of the board the task is in.

assignees.description: The people the task is assigned to.

due_date.description: The day the task is due as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

Attachment.description: A file attached to a post or comment.

file_name.description: The name the file had when it was uploaded.

content_type.description: The type found by looking at the content.

width.description: The width in pixels of an image, otherwise null.

height.description: The height in pixels of an image, otherwise null.

url.description: The path to download the file from, with the bearer token.

Reaction.description: One emoji on a post or comment.

count.description: How many people reacted with it.

users.description: The people, in the order they reacted.

mine.description: True when the user is one of them.

reactions.description: The reactions of the post as the user sees them, in the order each emoji was first used.

Post.description: A post, or a comment (a post with a parent).

id.description: The ID of the post. Newer posts have larger IDs.

parent_id.description: The post or comment this comment answers; null for a top-level post.

root_id.description: The top-level post of the thread; the post's own ID for a top-level post.

author.description: The author; null for a deleted post.

body.description: The body as written; null for a deleted post.

html.description: The body rendered safely for display (raw HTML in the body is escaped; a markdown body is rendered with GitHub-flavoured extensions); null for a deleted post. A client needs no markdown renderer.

tags.description: The tags, normalized, in the order given.

tasks.description: The tasks written in the post.

attachments.description: The files of the post, in the order they were attached.

reactions.description: The reactions, in the order each emoji was first used; the user's own are marked.

comment_count.description: The comments in the thread at any depth, not counting deleted ones; 0 for a comment.

edited_at.description: When the author last edited the post; null if never.

deleted.description: True for a post that stays only because it has replies; it has no author, body, tags, tasks, attachments or reactions.

can_edit.description: True when the user may edit it: its author.

can_delete.description: True when the user may delete it: its author or an admin.

id.description: On an edit, the ID of a task of the post that stays; left out for a new task.

assignee_ids.description: The IDs of members of the room to assign, at most 10.

due_date.description: The day it is due as YYYY-MM-DD; left out or null for none.

PostRequest.description: The body of a new post, a new comment and an edit. On a new post or comment a field that is left out is empty (the format is text); on an edit it keeps what the post has. A list that is there replaces the list.

format.description: How the body is written; text by default, and on an edit the post's own.

body.description: The body, at most 20,000 characters. A post needs a body, an attachment or a task.

tags.description: The tags: 1 to 50 letters, digits, - or _ each, with or without a leading #, at most 10. On an edit, exactly these tags replace the old ones.

tasks.description: The tasks, at most 20. On an edit, exactly these tasks: those with an id are edited, those without are new, the others are deleted.

upload_ids.description: The IDs of files uploaded with POST /uploads, to attach to the post. An ID is used once: the post takes it, and a post that is refused removes the file, so upload it again. An ID that is unknown, or that someone else uploaded, is 422 on this field. At most the attachment limit of the installation (10 by default) files per post, with the ones an edit keeps.

attachment_ids.description: On an edit, the IDs of the attachments of the post that stay; the others are removed. Left out keeps all of them. Not allowed on a new post or comment (422 unless empty).

Feed.description: A page of the feed of a room.

next_before.description: The before of the next page; null when this is the last.

ThreadComment.description: A comment of a thread with how deep it is.

depth.description: 1 for a reply to the top-level post, 2 for a reply to that, and so on, without limit.

Thread.description: A top-level post with all its comments.

comments.description: Every comment, in reading order: a comment comes before its replies and siblings are oldest first. Deleted comments that stay for their replies are included, as deleted.

focus_id.description: The ID of the comment the thread was asked for; null when it was asked for the top-level post.

tags.description: The tags, by name, at most 10.

UploadResult.description: A file uploaded and waiting to be attached to a post.

id.description: The upload ID, for upload_ids of a post or comment. Unguessable; it works for the user who uploaded the file.

file_name.description: The name the server keeps: only the base name, without control characters, at most 255 bytes.

content_type.description: The type found by looking at the content.

width.description: The width in pixels of an image, otherwise null.

height.description: The height in pixels of an image, otherwise null.

BoardTask.description: A card of the board: a task with the post it was written in and its place in its column.

column_id.description: The ID of the column of the board the task is in.

assignees.description: The people the task is assigned to.

due_date.description: The day the task is due as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

post_id.description: The ID of the post or comment the task was written in; GET /posts/{id}/thread opens its thread.

position.description: The place of the card in its column, from 0 at the top.

BoardColumn.description: A column of a board with its cards.

name.description: The name, 1 to 40 characters, unique in the room without regard to case.

position.description: The place of the column from the left, from 0.

done.description: True for the last column, which counts as done: its cards are never overdue.

tasks.description: The cards from top to bottom.

columns.description: The columns from left to right.

ColumnRequest.description: The name of a new column, or the new name of a column.

name.description: 1 to 40 characters, unique in the room without regard to case.

position.description: The place from the left, from 0. Below 0 is 0, past the end is the end.

column_id.description: The ID of a column of the same board.

position.description: The place in that column without the card, from 0 at the top. Below 0 is 0, past the end is the end.

TaskPatchRequest.description: A change to a card. A field that is not there stays as it is. The title is edited with the post (PATCH /posts/{id}), not here.

assignee_ids.description: The people the card is assigned to, members of the room, at most 10: the list replaces the old one and [] unassigns everybody. Null is like not there.

due_date.description: The day it is due as YYYY-MM-DD; null removes the due date.

RoomRef.description: A room named on a search result or a notification.

SnippetSegment.description: A piece of the matching text of a search result.

text.description: The piece as written: plain text, not escaped.

match.description: True for the words the query found.

SearchResult.description: A post or comment that a search found.

post_id.description: The ID of the post or comment.

root_id.description: The ID of the top-level post of its thread; the post itself for a top-level post.

kind.description: Whether it is a top-level post or a comment.

snippet.description: The matching text in pieces; joined, they are the text to show. Without words in the query it is the start of the post.

results.description: The results, by relevance and then newest first; newest first when the query has no words.

has_more.description: True when a next page has results.

Notification.description: Something that happened to the user or that involves them.

id.description: The ID of the notification; a larger ID is a newer one.

kind.description: Why the user is notified: an @mention, a comment under their post or comment, a task assigned to them, or their addition to a room by someone else.

actor.description: Who did it; null when that user is gone.

post_id.description: The post or comment of a mention, a reply or an assignment; null for an addition to a room. GET /posts/{id}/thread opens it.

task_id.description: The task of an assignment, otherwise null.

read.description: True when the user has marked it read.

NotificationList.description: A page of the notifications of the user.

next_before.description: The before of the next page; null when this is the last.

NotificationsReadRequest.description: How far the notifications are read.

up_to_id.description: The ID of the newest notification to mark read; every older one is marked too, newer ones stay unread.

Unauthenticated.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or of a user who is disabled, or (for a login) the username or password is wrong.

Forbidden.description: The user may see this but may not do it, for example post in a room they have not joined or edit someone else's post.

NotFound.description: There is no such thing, or the user may not know it exists.

Conflict.description: The change clashes with one made just now by someone else; try again.

InvalidInput.description: The body or a parameter breaks a rule; fields names each problem.

RateLimited.description: Too many failed logins for the username or the address.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; the length of the window of the limiter.

TooLarge.description: The JSON body is over 64 KiB, or the file of an upload is over the limit of the attachments.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The Content-Type of the body is not the one the route reads: application/json, or multipart/form-data for POST /uploads.

InternalError.description: The server failed. Nothing more is said about the cause.
